name: 15w vocabulary size comparison
title: Comparing a 4,096 and a 16,384 token vocabulary
subtitle: Story model; 1,500 held-out TinyStories stories, 228,247 words

steps.caption: The same stories take 2.219 tokens per word at 4,096 and 2.173 at 16,384.
Each token costs 22.03 million FLOPs at 4,096 and 31.47 million at 16,384.
Even 15% fewer tokens leaves the bigger vocabulary at 1.21 times the cost. It breaks even only at 30% fewer tokens.
Training stores 512 x V logits as 4-byte numbers for every row.
Four times as many rows share 2% fewer tokens, so each row is seen far less often.
